text: TAKING LESSONS FROM TRADITION—\n               GROWING STRONGER AND GREATER

label: common_0000_system_03
text: IT’S TIME FOR YOU, TOO...\n      TO DIVE INTO THE WORLD OF POKÉMON!

label: common_0000_system_04a
text: DIRECTOR CLAVELL\nHEAD OF NARANJA ACADEMY

label: common_0000_system_04b
text: DIRECTOR CLAVELL\nHEAD OF UVA ACADEMY

label: common_0000_system_05
text: Paldea is a sprawling region bursting with lush\nnature and magnificent landscapes.

label: common_0000_system_06
text: It is also, of course, home to the mysterious\ncreatures known to us as Pokémon.

label: common_0000_system_06_2
text: They reside here in great numbers, in fact.

label: common_0000_system_07
text: Pokémon can be found living all over: in the seas,\nin the skies—even in our cities and towns.

label: common_0000_system_08
text: We humans coexist with Pokémon, as we both\nhelp one another to live and thrive.

label: common_0000_system_09a
text: Naranja Academy is here to help you learn even\nmore about these precious partners.

label: common_0000_system_09b
text: Uva Academy is here to help you learn even\nmore about these precious partners.

label: common_0000_system_10
text: Within our halls, people from all regions gather\nto study together.

label: common_0000_system_11
text: And as Pokémon Trainers, they have their\nPokémon do battle, growing alongside them...

label: common_0000_system_12
text: while our robust curriculum of coursework helps\nour students draw forth their fullest potential.

label: common_0000_system_13
text: It is within these halls that you will find your\nfriends, your Pokémon, and your true self.

label: common_0000_system_14a
text: We, the faculty and staff at Naranja Academy,\ncan’t wait to welcome you with open arms.

label: common_0000_system_14b
text: We, the faculty and staff at Uva Academy,\ncan’t wait to welcome you with open arms.
